detail: The nonfatal PATH-alias EPERM warning triggered the original classifier. The process exited before thread.started because quoted dotted CLI override keys produced an invalid FilesystemPermissionToml value.
offlineVerification: Codex 0.163.0 config/src/overrides.rs splits override paths on literal dots. Inline TOML value reconstruction equals the unchanged hotfix.toml; SDK argument-forwarding and regression tests pass.
